description: Four delays set in milliseconds to two decimal places, from 0.01ms to 9999.99ms, working on audio or on CV. A delay time can be taken from a clock instead, with a multiplier applied to it

params.text: An attenuverter, -1 to +1, setting the level of the second input into that delay; it starts at zero
Balances the undelayed signal against the delayed one
How much of the delayed signal is fed back into the delay, -0.9999 to +0.9999

inputs.text: The main signal into that delay
A second signal into that delay, through its own gain control, so one delay can be fed from another
A clock sets the delay time for that delay, with the multiplier from its display applied
A voltage sets the delay time; the menu chooses the curve it maps through

notes: the millisecond display is dragged to set a delay time, from 0.01ms to 9999.99ms and 100ms by default; the multiplier display beside a clock input is dragged too, from 0.01 to 99.99
menu: Delay CV Input Mapping Modes — sets how the voltage at a CV input maps onto its delay time, as Old style mode, Exponential mode, Inverse Exponential mode, Logaritmic mode or Linear mode
